 Data Retrieval Files

The data files are uploaded and verified according to the details provided. The initial validation is performed using the Vendor File Name and its extension. In cases where a Vendor has multiple file exports with identical names, each duplicate is renamed by combining the Vendor File Name and Short Name. For instance, if the Vendor File Name is "Account_Summary" and the short name is "ASI", the updated file name would be "Account_Summary_ASI".

Vendor Report Name: This is the name of the report requested or retrieved from the Vendor. It is often a “friendly” name that describes the nature of the data it contains. As an example, if we retrieve the files via a website, the Vendor Report Name would be the name of the report as it is reflected within the Vendor’s online portal.

Vendor File Name: This is the actual name of the resulting file produced by the vendor when the report is requested or retrieved. Sometimes this is the same as the Vendor Report Name, but often it is different and contains additional identifying information like an internal vendor identifier, account number, bill period date, etc.

Short Name: This is the shortened and standardized name we assign to the file to help with internal communication and filing naming conventions.
